title: Structural Weaknesses Beyond XCB-Style Modes
summary: A known attack is specific to XCB-style modes with polynomial hashing; whether analogous weaknesses affect other TEM classes or symmetric designs remains open.

formal_statement.body: An attack specifically targets XCB-style modes with polynomial hashing. Determine whether other classes of TEMs or symmetric designs are vulnerable to structural weaknesses analogous to those exploited by the attack on XCB-style modes with polynomial hashing.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of XCB-style modes, TEMs, and symmetric designs.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether other classes of TEMs or symmetric designs are vulnerable to analogous structural weaknesses.

citations.label: Breaking the IEEE Encryption Standard -- XCB-AES in Two Queries

progress.summary: The source reports an attack tailored to XCB-style modes with polynomial hashing, then asks whether similar structural exploits extend to other TEMs or symmetric designs.
citation_labels: Amit Singh Bhati et al., Breaking the IEEE Encryption Standard -- XCB-AES in Two Queries
